learning_objective: 🎯 Let's discover how to use colorful threads, needles, and fabric to draw beautiful pictures and tell amazing woven stories!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Instead of using a pencil on paper, artists can use a needle and thread on cloth! Running stitches look like beautiful dotted lines that form amazing pictures.
Applique is a fun technique where we cut out shapes from different colored clothes and stitch them onto a bigger piece of fabric to make a bright scene.
A quilt is made of many fabric squares sewn together. We can embroider a different part of a story on each square to make a giant, cozy storybook!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Cardboard Lacing Art!
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a star on a piece of thick cardboard. Ask an adult to punch holes along the outline, then use a thick shoelace to stitch your beautiful star!

quick_recap: ⭐ Thread and needle can be used just like crayons to color on fabric.
⭐ Sewing different pieces of cloth together is called applique.
⭐ Story quilts are magical blankets that tell a tale through stitched pictures.
